name: xdBot (CBF fork)
description: Zilko's xdBot, ported to GD 2.2081, with a sub-tick stepper and clicks between frames (kept in .cml)

frame_offset.name: Frame Offset
frame_offset.description: Adds a frame offset when recording or playing macros

endscreen_button.name: Button at Endscreen
endscreen_button.description: Shows the menu button at the endscreen.

ffmpeg_path.name: ffmpeg.exe Path
ffmpeg_path.description: The path for ffmpeg.exe, needed to use render.

editor_keybinds.name: Keybinds on editor
editor_keybinds.description: Enables keybinds while on the level editor.

recording_only_keybinds.name: Keybinds only while recording
recording_only_keybinds.description: Keybinds only work while recording a macro.

level_settings_button.name: Show Button At Settings
level_settings_button.description: Shows the xdBot button in the level settings layer.

restore_page.name: Restore Settings Page
restore_page.description: Saves the page you were in when you closed the menu.

disable_speedhack.name: Auto Disable Speedhack
disable_speedhack.description: Disables Speedhack when exiting a level.

frame_fixes_limit.name: Frame Fixes Limit in FPS
frame_fixes_limit.description: Limits how many frame fixes per second there will be.

auto_stop_playing.name: Auto Stop Playing
auto_stop_playing.description: Stops playing the macro when it ends.

key_open_menu.name: Open Menu
key_open_menu.description: Opens or closes the xdBot menu.

key_step_frame.name: Advance frame
key_step_frame.description: Advances one frame if frame stepper is on (hold to keep going).

key_stepper_toggle.name: Stepper on / off
key_stepper_toggle.description: Turns the sub-tick stepper on or off in a level (also in the pause menu). While it's on, the level only moves when you step it, and your clicks go into the macro where the stepper is.

key_stepper_tick.name: Stepper: next frame
key_stepper_tick.description: Runs one frame. Hold it to keep going (60 frames a second).

key_stepper_tick_back.name: Stepper: frame back
key_stepper_tick_back.description: Back one frame (to a checkpoint the stepper kept).

key_stepper_fine.name: Stepper: small step
key_stepper_fine.description: Moves one small step inside the frame (Stepper: steps a second). A click placed there lands that far into the frame.

key_stepper_hold.name: Stepper: press / let go of jump
key_stepper_hold.description: Presses jump where the stepper is, or lets go of it if it's held there.

key_stepper_play.name: Stepper: play / stop
key_stepper_play.description: Plays the macro from here at the game's speed (stops at a death).

key_stepper_return.name: Stepper: back to where play started
key_stepper_return.description: Goes back to where you last pressed play.

key_stepper_pull.name: Stepper: next click here
key_stepper_pull.description: Moves the next click of the macro to where the stepper is.

key_stepper_delete.name: Stepper: delete next click
key_stepper_delete.description: Takes the next click of the macro out.

key_stepper_undo.name: Stepper: undo
key_stepper_undo.description: Undoes the last edit of the macro's clicks.

key_stepper_mark.name: Stepper: mark
key_stepper_mark.description: Marks the last press (or where the stepper is): two marks give the window between them.

stepper_hz.name: Stepper: steps a second
stepper_hz.description: How finely the stepper splits a frame: 2400 = steps of 0.1 frame at 240 TPS. GD's float timing makes the very finest steps stop mattering (one float step of 1/240 s is about 1e-7 frame).

stepper_deaths.name: Stepper: deaths
stepper_deaths.description: Stop in front of a frame that kills the player (it's undone), or go through it like noclip.

stepper_back.name: Stepper: frames you can go back
stepper_back.description: A checkpoint is kept before every frame the stepper runs, this many at most. More uses more memory.

stepper_panel.name: Stepper: panel
stepper_panel.description: The panel at the bottom: buttons, and the macro's clicks as a timeline you can select, move and delete.

stepper_ghost.name: Stepper: ghost
stepper_ghost.description: An outline where the player will be at the stepper's spot inside the coming frame.

stepper_trajectory_boxes.name: Stepper: hitboxes on the trajectory
stepper_trajectory_boxes.description: With Show Trajectory on (the panel's Path button), the player's hitbox along the hold path.
